text:
tanya: quick follow-up from the midnight collapse postmortem. want to lock owners for remediation, SLO guidance, and a short retro on the recurring pattern.
kevin: summary pls (numbers + impact).
tanya: p95 stayed ~190ms, p99 hit ~1.9s for ~20m (00:40-01:00 UTC). throughput dropped ~65%. rolling-week error-budget burn ~20%. pattern seen 4x in last month.
li: root cause notes: simultaneous model pool drains + large client fanouts cause queue pile-ups; autoscaler reacts too slowly.
metrics-bot: incident-3301122334 created: https://incidents.redwood/3301122334  linked to throughput-regressions.
tanya: mitigation ideas (concise): 1) standby-reservoir: keep tiny always-warm reserve of instances per region (infra) 2) route safety-mode: automatic partial-failover to lite-model if tail latency > 1s for 2m (li) 3) client-side smoothing recommendations + edge backpressure (kevin) 4) dashboard + error-budget projection + per-customer SLA headroom panel (kevin).
kevin: prefer safety-mode + standby-reservoir over changing SLOs. keeps SLA semantics intact and reduces noisy alerts.
bizops: product impact note  if safety-mode shifts traffic for >30m cumulative for an SLA customer we need to notify.
li: owners + deadlines proposal: infra-team - standby-reservoir PR + staging canary by Mon; li - safety-mode prototype + canary Tue; kevin - dashboard + error-budget panel by Thu EOD; tanya - runbook + exec brief by Fri.
kevin: dashboard draft query I'll add (prometheus):
```
# p99 by instance warm tag and safety_mode flag for /v1/predict
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/predict"}[5m])) by (le, instance_warm, safety_mode))
```
li: safety-mode plan: when p99>1s for 2m, mark route safety_mode=true and shift 25% traffic to lite-variant; escalate to pager only if safety_mode=true AND error_budget_burn>5%/day.
infra-team: standby-reservoir plan: reserve 4 instances per region flagged as standby_reservoir=true in pool-manager. will open PR today; staging canary Wed 00:30, prod Fri 00:30. cost impact estimate in PR.
kevin: add an error-budget projection panel (current burn rate -> days-to-zero) and a table of top 10 customers by SLA headroom so CS can triage.
bizops: we'll prepare a short customer message template to use if notification is needed. keep wording conservative.
metrics-bot: action items recorded on incident checklist: infra-team(standby-reservoir), li(safety-mode), kevin(dashboard), tanya(runbook). Deadlines logged.
tanya: decision check: keep global SLOs unchanged, implement standby-reservoir + safety-mode + dashboard work, notify SLA customers only if safety-mode affects them >30m. react with :thumbsup: to approve.
kevin: :thumbsup:
li: :thumbsup:
infra-team: :thumbsup:
bizops: :thumbsup:
tanya: blocking question  do we want to trial standby-reservoir only during known high-risk windows (midnight rollouts) or always-on? cost vs benefit tradeoff.
kevin: start with rollout windows as a low-cost test, toggle to always-on if spikes persist. add an infra flag to control.
infra-team: we'll implement a schedule flag in PR and include cost delta in description.
li: i'll prepare regression test for safety-mode in CI to avoid flapping.
kevin: also add a composite alert: page only when p99>900ms for 5m AND queue_depth>threshold; otherwise slack alert. reduces pager noise.
metrics-bot: alert rule preview created: https://alerts.redwood/r/3301122334.
tanya: ok owners, please update statuses in the incident tracker as PRs land. i'll put together a 1-pager for exec sync tomorrow and include the customer note draft. if anything blocks owners raise here and we'll escalate. :eyes:
